name: d3
description: One docs system in the repo that people and any coding agent share, so nobody has to guess from code: init (docs/, templates, AGENTS.md, PR template, docs CI), prime (load the docs a task needs), spec, capture (plans with acceptance criteria, ADRs, audits, incidents, rules, flows…), check (zero-dependency docs linter with citation drift), review (PR vs plan and ADRs), status.
